title: Acyclic Leray for derived evaluation without Ext
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and i: X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous finite-limit-preserving functor with additive sheaf pushforward T [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let Z evaluate an abelian Zariski sheaf at the top open, and E evaluate an abelian etale sheaf at i(top). For all etale sheaves F [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with R^(n+1)T(F)=0 for every n >= 0, there exist simultaneously additive equivalences c(F,hF,n): R^(n+1)Z(T(F)) -> R^(n+1)E(F), natural for all morphisms between these T-acyclic sheaves. No HasExt model, free representable, constant integer sheaf, or terminality hypothesis appears in this statement.

source.place: Lemma 21.14.6(1), direct resolution proof; Tag 072Z for preserved injectives

proof.text: Finite-limit-preserving i is representably flat; its continuous set-valued inverse image is left exact. The abelian-group-object lift is left exact and a left adjoint, hence exact. Its right adjoint T preserves injectives. Use an essentially small model of the etale site with the same coefficient universe.

Choose an injective resolution I of a T-acyclic F. Left exactness identifies degree-zero kernel with T(F), and positive homology of T(I) equals R^q T(F)=0. T preserves injectives, so T(I) is an injective resolution of T(F). Compute derived evaluations using these resolutions. Evaluation of T(I) at top is evaluation of I at i(top), so the section complexes coincide.

Lift F -> G to their injective resolutions and apply T. The identical section complexes commute with these lifts; naturality of derived-resolution computations gives the equation. Homotopic lifts give equal homology maps and proof irrelevance removes dependence on acyclicity witnesses.

theorem etaleZariskiDerivedSectionsAcyclicLeray
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    [i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology]
    [(i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits i] :
    let T := i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology
    let Z := sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)
    let E := sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
      (CategoryTheory.evaluation X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op (i.obj ⊤))
    ∃ c : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F)) (n : ℕ),
        ((Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj (T.obj F)) ≃+
          ((E.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F),
      ∀ (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u})
        (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj F))
        (hG : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero ((T.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj G))
        (φ : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) (x : (Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).obj (T.obj F)),
        c G hG n ((Z.rightDerived (n + 1)).map (T.map φ) x) =
          (E.rightDerived (n + 1)).map φ (c F hF n x)
